gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Noto Sans Khmer has generous openings and small letters that stand almost as tall as capitals. Nordic goes the other way, cramped and brushy with a monoweight stroke, so it hits hard while the body simply lets you read.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Noto Sans Khojki reads light and open, with exits wide enough to pass light and a big clear eye on every e. Nordic holds one line width through every turn; the sans simply stays easy.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Nordic arrives with a cramped, ancient punch. Noto Sans Khudawadi leaves its rounds unsealed like an unlatched hook, so if the heading were made small it would lose its weight while the body stays friendly and open.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-kr: Nordic draws a plain, unmodulated outline with brush-dab spacing and a pressed-leaf squeeze in each opening, which gives it an old, powerful feel. Noto Sans KR stays generous in its curves and stubby in its stems.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-lao: Noto Sans Lao pushes its x-height well above the usual and keeps its mouths open on c, e, and a. Nordic's tubular, wire-like letters do the shouting; the plain sans does the explaining.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-lao-loope: Noto Sans Lao Looped makes words read as solid blocks rather than skylines, with bowls left unfinished on one side. Nordic's pen-like line of constant weight sits above it, tight and ancient, while the body moves along.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Noto Sans Lepcha has curves with a wide opening and a lowercase built like cast iron capitals. Nordic, by contrast, pinches its letters shut, so that body text feels like a steady walk after a heavy knock at the door.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Nordic is powerful and ancient, its letters pinched closed. Noto Sans Limbu gapes in its curves with tall-bodied small letters, so the heading carries the weight while the sans carries the talking.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Noto Sans Lisu reads crisp and open, with tiny gaps between ascender tops and the x-height line and wide s curves. And Nordic, drawn like a technical drafting pen, holds the heading while the body keeps text moving.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-lydian: A drafting pen's steady line runs through Nordic, with spacing like brush dabs placed far apart. And Noto Sans Lydian answers its closed letters with an opening as wide as a sprung paper clip, plain and approachable.
